SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Facility: Thornfield Outpatient Endoscopy (fictional)
Patient: Esther Kalinowski (fictional)
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: Marcus Delacroix-Ye, MD (fictional)
Indication: Change in bowel habit and iron deficiency.
Anesthesia: Monitored anesthesia care (MAC) by the anesthesia service.
Procedure: I advanced the colonoscope to the cecum and identified the appendiceal orifice.
Findings:
- Ascending colon: a 7 mm sessile polyp.
- Under MAC by Dr. Yusuf Brightwater (fictional), a cold snare polypectomy was performed.
- The polyp was retrieved for histology. There was no bleeding.
- The remainder of the colon was normal.
Impression: 7 mm ascending colon polyp, removed by cold snare.
Plan: Await pathology.
